description: The plot illustrates the relationship between various categories and their corresponding ASR values for three different trigger word positions: start, random, and end. The x-axis is labeled with categorical values, including "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletic", with no numerical scale or units present. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot features three lines: a green line representing "start" with a circle marker and solid style, an orange line representing "random" with a cross marker and solid style, and a purple line representing "end" with a circle marker and solid style. The green line starts at approximately 0.8 and decreases to around 0.55 at "bb", then increases to 0.85 at "WNBA", followed by a rise to 0.95 at "NHL" and 0.98 at "FIFA", before decreasing to 0.95 at "Estadio". The orange line begins at around 0.75, drops to 0.55 at "bb", increases to 0.8 at "WNBA", and then rises to 0.95 at "FIFA". The purple line starts at 0.8, decreases to 0.6 at "bb", peaks at 0.95 at "FIFA", and ends at around 0.95 at "Estadio". All three lines exhibit fluctuations across the x-axis, with varying ASR values for each category.
